COLDWAR_GRE_1970_set_leader = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
		}
		update_set_politics = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_zolotas
					OR = {
						NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_0_zolotas } }
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Xenophon Zolotas" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_0_zolotas
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_0_zolotas
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_papadopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_ioannidis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_gizikis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_karamanlis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_andreas_papandreou
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_mavros
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_florakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_constantine_ii
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_zoitakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_kanellopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_koligiannis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_angellis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_bonanos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_arapakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_davos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_papanikolaou
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_rallis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_averoff
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_mitsotakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_evert
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_farakos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_kyrkos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_drakopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_markezinis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_androutsopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_pattakos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_tzannetakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_zolotas
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_tsatsos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_sartzetakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_stephanopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_damanaki
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_konstantopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_simitis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_papariga
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_kostas_karamanlis
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_0_zolotas
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_zolotas
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Xenophon Zolotas" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
					retire_country_leader = yes
					create_country_leader = { name = "Xenophon Zolotas" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_zolotas.dds" desc = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_zolotas_desc ideology = Western_Autocracy }
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_zolotas
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_0_zolotas
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Xenophon Zolotas" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
					retire_country_leader = yes
					create_country_leader = { name = "Xenophon Zolotas" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_zolotas.dds" desc = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_zolotas_desc ideology = Western_Autocracy }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_karamanlis
					OR = {
						NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_karamanlis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kanellopoulos has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_rallis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_averoff has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_mitsotakis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_evert has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_tzannetakis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_stephanopoulos has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kostas_karamanlis } }
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Konstantinos Karamanlis" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_karamanlis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kanellopoulos
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_rallis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_averoff
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_mitsotakis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_evert
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_tzannetakis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_stephanopoulos
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kostas_karamanlis
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_karamanlis
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_kanellopoulos
					OR = {
						NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_karamanlis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kanellopoulos has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_rallis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_averoff has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_mitsotakis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_evert has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_tzannetakis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_stephanopoulos has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kostas_karamanlis } }
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Panagiotis Kanellopoulos" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_karamanlis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kanellopoulos
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_rallis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_averoff
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_mitsotakis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_evert
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_tzannetakis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_stephanopoulos
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kostas_karamanlis
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kanellopoulos
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_rallis
					OR = {
						NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_karamanlis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kanellopoulos has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_rallis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_averoff has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_mitsotakis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_evert has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_tzannetakis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_stephanopoulos has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kostas_karamanlis } }
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Georgios Rallis" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_karamanlis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kanellopoulos
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_rallis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_averoff
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_mitsotakis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_evert
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_tzannetakis
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_stephanopoulos
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_kostas_karamanlis
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_1_rallis
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {

					create_country_leader = { name = "Grigorios Bonanos" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_bonanos.dds" desc = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_bonanos_desc ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_22_markezinis
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_markezinis
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Spyros Markezinis" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
					retire_country_leader = yes
					create_country_leader = { name = "Spyros Markezinis" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_markezinis.dds" desc = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_markezinis_desc ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_22_androutsopoulos
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_androutsopoulos
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Adamantios Androutsopoulos" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
					retire_country_leader = yes
					create_country_leader = { name = "Adamantios Androutsopoulos" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_androutsopoulos.dds" desc = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_androutsopoulos_desc ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_22_pattakos
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_pattakos
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Stylianos Pattakos" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
					retire_country_leader = yes
					create_country_leader = { name = "Stylianos Pattakos" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pattakos.dds" desc = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pattakos_desc ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_papadopoulos
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_22_papadopoulos
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Georgios Papadopoulos" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
					retire_country_leader = yes
					create_country_leader = { name = "Georgios Papadopoulos" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_papadopoulos.dds" desc = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_papadopoulos_desc ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 23 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_constantine_ii
					OR = {
						NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_23_constantine_ii } }
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Constantine II" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_23_constantine_ii
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_23_constantine_ii
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_papadopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_ioannidis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_gizikis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_karamanlis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_andreas_papandreou
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_mavros
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_florakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_constantine_ii
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_zoitakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_kanellopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_koligiannis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_angellis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_bonanos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_arapakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_davos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_papanikolaou
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_rallis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_averoff
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_mitsotakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_evert
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_farakos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_kyrkos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_drakopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_markezinis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_androutsopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_pattakos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_tzannetakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_zolotas
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_tsatsos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_sartzetakis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_stephanopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_damanaki
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_konstantopoulos
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_simitis
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_papariga
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_kostas_karamanlis
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_23_constantine_ii
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_constantine_ii
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Constantine II" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
					retire_country_leader = yes
					create_country_leader = { name = "Constantine II" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_constantine_ii.dds" desc = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_constantine_ii_desc ideology = Monarchist }
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_selected_constantine_ii
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_preference_23_constantine_ii
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_leader = { name = "Constantine II" ruling_only = yes } }
					}
					retire_country_leader = yes
					create_country_leader = { name = "Constantine II" picture = "gfx/leaders/GRE/1970/COLDWAR_GRE_1970_constantine_ii.dds" desc = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_constantine_ii_desc ideology = Monarchist }
				}
			}
		}
		set_correct_ideology_trait = yes
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_leader_party = ruling_party }
		COLDWAR_GRE_1970_leadership_changed = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_GRE_1970_retire_modern_roster = yes
		COLDWAR_GRE_1970_refresh_roster = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_undated_leadership_initialized } NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_leader_party = ruling_party } } }
			}
			COLDWAR_GRE_1970_set_leader = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_undated_leadership_initialized
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_daily_tick = {
	COLDWAR_GRE_1970_initialize = yes
}
